## 1100 - 1125

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1100 CV - Observed to base CTL out of validation limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01100">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meters and Tickets.

When the “Run on Imports and Edits” option is enabled in the Product Editor, FLOWCAL will compare the imported Observed to Base CTL to the FLOWCAL calculated Observed to Base CTL. If the values differ by more than the discrimination set on the Product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Crude product using Table A 2004 is configured with a discrimination of 4 for Observed to Base CTL. If an Observed to Base CTL is imported of 0.99856 and FLOWCAL calculates 0.99854, then this exception will be generated.

The discrimination for Observed to Base CTL is set on the Validations \> Density tab in the Product Editor

</div>

#### 1109 CV - Unable to calculate (indicated volume missing) (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01110">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1110 CV - COSTALD has incomplete analysis due to invalid or missing mol%</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01110">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data that have a Product configured with one of the of the following product tables:

- COSTALD (Meters only)
- Table E (TP27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density – C3
- Table E (TP27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density – C4

For meters, one of the following options must be enabled:

- The Product option “Sample Required for Batch Meter” on the Product tab in the Product Editor
- The Meter option “Sample Required” for the Valid Product on the Liquids tab in the Meter Editor

If one or both of these options are enabled and a meter record is created or modified that does not have values for the Mole % on the Analysis, or that total 0%, then this exception will be generated.

For Tickets, if the Product has the option “Sample Required for Standalone Ticket” enabled and a ticket is created or edited that does not have values for the Mole % on the Analysis, or that total 0%, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01111">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1111 CV - Observed density does not equal uncorrected time DMF</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01111">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

When the “Observed Density Tolerance” option is defined in System Configuration, FLOWCAL will compare the provided Observed Density to the FLOWCAL calculated Observed Density using the provided Uncorrected Density and DMF. If the difference between the provided Observed Density and FLOWCAL calculated Observed Density is greater than the Observed Density Tolerance defined in the FLOWCAL Options, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Observed Density Tolerance is set to 0.0001 and a Meter Ticket is created that has an Uncorrected Density of 0.5050 REL, Observed Density = 0.5050, and DMF of 1.0005. The FLOWCAL Calculated Observed Density is 0.5052525 REL (0.5050\*1.0005). The difference between the provided and FLOWCAL calculated is 0.0002525, which is greater than the Observed Density Tolerance so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01112">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1112 CV - Pressure compensated (CPL is not equal to 1.0 on file import)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01112">

This exception applies to imported Liquid Meter and Ticket Data.

For Meters, if the meter is configured with Pressure Compensated set to Yes in Meter Characteristics, or the import file has Pressure Compensated = Y, and a CPL value other than 1 is imported, then this exception will be generated.

For Tickets, if the import file has Pressure Compensated = Y and a CPL value other than 1 is imported, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a TFX file containing a Meter Ticket is imported with Pressure Compensated = Y and CPL = 1.0062. Calculations will assume a CPL value of 1 and this exception will be generated to alert the user.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01113">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1113 CV - Temperature compensated (CTL is not equal to 1.0 on file import)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01113">

For Meters, if the meter is configured with Temperature Compensated set to Yes in Meter Characteristics, or the import file has Temperature Compensated = Y, and a CTL value other than 1 is imported, then this exception will be generated. For Tickets, if the import file has Temperature Compensated = Y and a CTL value other than 1 is imported, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a TFX file containing a Meter Ticket is imported with Temperature Compensated = Y and CTL = 0.9985. Calculations will assume a CTL value of 1 and this exception will be generated to alert the user.

</div>

- The Meter option “Sample Required” for the Valid Product on the Liquids tab in the Meter Editor

If one or both of these options are enabled and a meter record is created or modified that does not have values for the Mass % on the Analysis, or that total 0%, then this exception will be generated.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01119">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1119 CV - Sample missing relative density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01119">

This exception applies to imported and edited Liquid Meter and Ticket Data that have a Product configured with the Product Table “Table E (TP27) Alt .Base and Obs. Density - Nat. Gasoline”.

If a Meter record is created or edited that does not have a value for Relative Density on the Analysis, or that is less than or equal to 0, but Mole %, Mass%, or LV% total greater than 0%, then this exception will be generated.

If a ticket is created or edited that does not have values for the Relative Density on the Analysis, or that is less than or equal to 0, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Meter record is created that has a Product configured with the Product Table “Table E (TP27) Alt. Base and Obs. Density – Nat. Gasoline”. The Meter Analysis attached to that record has a Relative Density of 0 and a Mass % that totals to 100%. Because the total for Mass % is greater than 0 and Relative Density is equal to 0, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01120">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1120 CV - Mass heating value not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01120">

This exception applies to imported and edited Gas Flow Data for Meters.

For Gas Meters with a Meter Type other than Coriolis, if the meter is configured with a Mass Calculation Method is of “From Energy (Alt)” and a meter record is created with Mass Heating Value not provided on the analysis, then this exception will be generated.

For Gas Meters with a Meter Type of Coriolis, if the meter is configured with an Energy Calculation Method is of “From Mass (Alt)” and a meter record is created with Mass Heating Value not provided on the analysis, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01121">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1121 CV – DP<sub>Y</sub> not available on import for AGA-3 2013 with API 21.1 (2013)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01121">

This exception is generated upon import for a gas orifice meter with calculation method set to AGA-3 2013 and DP usage set to API 21.1 (2013). DP<sub>Y</sub> can be imported using the CFX format. If a flow data periodic record imported into an applicable meter does not include DP<sub>Y</sub> value, this exception is generated. This exception gets resolved when DP<sub>Y</sub> is calculated and is not null anymore.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01122">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1122 CV – DP<sub>Y</sub> undefined; unable to perform Y-factor calculation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01122">

This exception is generated for a gas orifice meter with calculation method set to AGA3-2013 and DP usage set to API 21.1 (2013) upon import or edit, when calculation is triggered. Cutoff alarm limit is not defined. API 21.1 (2013) calculation uses DP<sub>Y</sub> to calculate expansion factor (Y). If DP<sub>Y</sub> is not defined so that calculation is not able to calculate a Y factor, this exception is generated.

This exception is also generated when DP<sub>Y</sub> is calculated to be less than 0. If DP<sub>Y</sub> is calculated to be less than 0, DP<sub>Y</sub> is not stored or displayed, and no further calculation takes place.

This exception gets resolved when DP<sub>Y</sub> is a positive value.

For example, a meter is set with AGA-3 2013 calculation method and API 21.1 (2013) DP usage. The pressure is absolute pressure. The extension definition is SQRT(DP\*P). From the EFM, following flow parameters are imported:

- DP: 0.210326 inches of water
- P: 485.34 psia
- T: 74.06 °F
- Flow time: 3456 seconds
- Extension: 21.7863

Then DP<sub>IV</sub> is calculated to be 0.97795 … inches of water. Using the DP and DP<sub>IV</sub> value, DP<sub>Y</sub> calculation is then attempted, and the result is -0.16694 … inches of water. This negative value is not valid as DP<sub>Y</sub>. Therefore, the exception 1122 is generated and calculation is stopped.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01123">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1123 CV – Unable to calculate DP<sub>Y</sub>; DP<sub>IV</sub> undefined or below cutoff, DP above cutoff</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01123">

This exception is generated for a gas orifice meter with calculation method set to AGA-3 2013 and DP usage set to API 21.1 (2013) upon import or edit, when calculation is triggered. Cutoff alarm limit is defined. API 21.1 (2013) calculation calculates DP<sub>Y</sub> from DP and DP<sub>IV</sub>. If DP is valid and above cutoff alarm limit and DP<sub>IV</sub> is null for any reason, or if DP is valid and above cutoff, and DP<sub>IV</sub> is less than cutoff alarm limit, no further calculation takes place and DP<sub>Y</sub> is not calculated.

For example, a meter is set with AGA-3 2013 calculation method and API 21.1 (2013) DP usage. The pressure is absolute pressure. The extension definition is SQRT(DP\*P). Cutoff alarm limit is 0.40 inches of water. From the EFM, following flow parameters are imported:

- DP: 49.785 inches of water
- P: 485.34 psia
- T: 74.06 °F
- Flow time: 3456 seconds
- Extension: 9.5873

Then DP<sub>IV</sub> is calculated to be 0.18938 … inches of water. DP of 48.785 inches of water is above the cutoff alarm limit of 0.40 inches of water. However, DP<sub>IV</sub> of 0.1894 inches of water is below the cutoff alarm limit. Therefore, the exception 1123 is generated and calculation is stopped.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01124">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1124 CV – Unable to calculate DP<sub>Y</sub>; DP is undefined</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01124">

This exception is generated for a gas orifice meter with calculation method set to AGA-3 2013 and DP usage set to API 21.1 (2013) upon import or edit, when calculation is triggered. API 21.1 (2013) calculation calculates DP<sub>Y</sub> from DP. If no value is provided for DP, calculation cannot take place and this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="01125">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />1125 CV – DP is below the back flow limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="01125">

This exception is generated for a gas orifice meter with calculation method set to AGA-3 2013 and DP usage set to API 21.1 (2013) upon import or edit, when calculation is triggered. Back flow alarm limit is defined. This exception is generated if DP is less than the back flow alarm limit. This does not stop the calculation.

</div>

</div>
